finding.claim: Embed extension fetches any attacker-supplied https:// URL server-side when allowed_domains is empty (fail-open default, SSRF).
finding.source: Markdown block line beginning with https:// (EmbedStartParser.php:34-51)
finding.sink: OscaroteroEmbedAdapter.php:43 getMulti() server-side fetch of the URL

trace.note: any line starting with https:// is accepted as an embed destination
DomainFilteringAdapter only installed when list is non-empty; empty list = allow all

finding.guards_checked: Scheme must be https (parser). Domain allowlist (DomainFilteringAdapter.php:40-61) is only applied when allowed_domains is non-empty; default config has no host restriction. Block-level-only restriction (EmbedProcessor.php:45) does not limit host choice.

finding.claim: Embed HTML returned by the adapter is emitted verbatim, bypassing the html_input escape/strip setting.
finding.source: Remote response HTML from the URL in an embed block (attacker-hosted page or user content on an allowlisted host)
finding.sink: EmbedRenderer.php:33 returns getEmbedCode() unfiltered into rendered output

trace.note: attacker-chosen https URL becomes an Embed node
returns the stored HTML raw; no html_input check
contrast: HtmlBlockRenderer.php:44 and HtmlInlineRenderer.php:44 do consult html_input for raw HTML, EmbedRenderer does not

finding.guards_checked: html_input filtering (applied only to raw HTML block/inline nodes, not Embed nodes). Only effective when the embed adapter is configured and the URL is fetchable (see F1). Operator must set html_input to escape or strip for the bypass to matter.

finding.claim: allow_unsafe_links defaults to true, so GithubFlavoredMarkdownConverter renders javascript:/vbscript:/file:/data: links and image sources from untrusted Markdown by default.
finding.source: Markdown link or image destination, e.g. [x](javascript:alert(1)), supplied by any Markdown author
finding.sink: LinkRenderer.php:48-49 and ImageRenderer.php:50-55 emit href/src unfiltered

trace.note: constructs Environment with caller config only; no override of allow_unsafe_links
forbidUnsafeLinks false, so href = node URL unchecked

finding.guards_checked: RegexHelper::isLinkPotentiallyUnsafe (RegexHelper.php:239-247) runs only when allow_unsafe_links is false. Attributes filter (AttributesHelper.php:172) also gated on the same flag. Design default of the library, not a code defect; flagged because the GFM entry point offers no safe default.
